hypothesis: Fusing local shift, target extraction, exponentiation, and partial denominator accumulation into one rank-local kernel reduces PyTorch elementwise/indexing kernel-launch overhead while preserving the required collective ordering.
collective_policy: Caller performs the real MAX all-reduce after local_max_fp16 and the two real SUM all-reduces after local_prepare_fp16.
inputs: local FP16 logits [N,V/2], global int64 targets [N], global FP32 max [N]
outputs: per-row partial predicted exp, partial denominator, target exp, local-target mask, local target index
